title: The Reflecting Pool Drama: Algae, Arrests, and a $14 Million Makeover
summary:
Have you ever watched a home makeover show where everything goes wrong? That's kind of what's happening with the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C. President Trump said in April that it would take just two weeks and $2 million to resurface the pool in "American flag blue" for the Fourth of July. But months later, the pool is still empty and fenced off, and the cost has ballooned to over $14 million!

Here's what went down. After workers painted the pool blue, algae turned the water bright green. Protesters showed up in funny costumes, cheering for "Team Algae." Then, chunks of the new blue lining started peeling off. Trump blamed vandals with box cutters, and several people were arrested—including a former Olympic canoeist named David Hearn. But some experts say the paint job was just badly done by a company that got the contract without competing for it.

The pool was drained again after July Fourth to clean up fireworks debris and fix the damage. Now, it's become a huge online sensation. Google searches for "reflecting pool" are up over 5,000%! People are treating it like a reality TV show, posting memes and following every twist. One professor says it's a perfect distraction from heavier news. "How can you look away from that?" she said. For many, the messy pool has become a symbol of bigger problems in the government.
why_it_matters: This story shows that even big plans by important leaders can go hilariously wrong, and it is okay to laugh at mistakes while still learning from them.

keywords.explanation: To resurface something means to put a new top layer on it, like giving a pool a fresh coat of paint or concrete.
When a cost ballooned, it quickly grew much bigger than expected, like a balloon blowing up.
Algae is a tiny green plant that grows in water, sometimes turning entire pools bright green.
Vandals are people who purposely damage or destroy property that does not belong to them.
A contract is an official written agreement that explains what work someone will do and how much they will be paid.
Debris is the scattered pieces and trash left behind after something, like fireworks or a storm.

background_read: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool is a long, shallow pool in front of the Lincoln Memorial, a giant statue and building honoring President Abraham Lincoln in Washington, D.C., the U.S. capital.
It is part of the National Mall, a park with many famous monuments, and has been the scene of historic events like Martin Luther King Jr.’s 'I Have a Dream' speech in 1963.
Because it is such an important and iconic place, millions of tourists visit every year, and anything that happens there quickly becomes big news.
Article_Structure: WHO: President Trump, a painting company, protesters, and former Olympic canoeist David Hearn.
WHAT: A pool resurfacing project that turned into an expensive, algae-filled, meme-worthy mess with arrests.
WHERE: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C.
WHY: The pool was meant to shine for the Fourth of July, but rushed work and no competition for the contract led to a string of failures.
